# CANDIDATE: MSS_VWAP_RETEST_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-09-07  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

After a bullish break of structure (BOS) on the 5‑min chart, a retest of the broken level that finds support at VWAP and a bullish ribbon alignment offers a high‑probability long. The edge exists because BOS establishes institutional intent, VWAP retest provides liquidity-driven support, and EMA ribbon alignment confirms momentum persistence, creating a confluence of structural, volume, and trend factors.

## Mechanism

Entry rule: When a higher‑high/higher‑low structure is identified (price makes a new HH followed by a HL) and subsequently pulls back to within 0.2 % of the prior swing low (the broken level) AND the low of that retest bar is ≥ VWAP AND EMA8 > EMA21 > EMA55 (bullish ribbon), enter long at the close of the retest bar. Exit shape: Stop just below the retested level (chart‑stop); target at the prior swing high or 1.5 R, with a runner that trails 15 % off the highest‑water‑mark after the target is reached. Regime hint: Works in trending regimes (price above the 15‑min 200‑EMA) and VIX between 12‑22; avoid the first 20 minutes after open to let the BOS form.
